description: Test cases for array traversal optimization problems

test_cases.student_query: How do I find the maximum sum of k consecutive elements efficiently?
test_cases.student_work: Drew array, wrote nested loop solution with O(n*k) complexity

expected_ai_behavior.interpretation: Student has correct brute force, needs optimization insight
expected_ai_behavior.pedagogical_approach: Guide to see the overlapping work in their current solution

success_criteria: AI recognizes correct but inefficient approach
AI asks about repeated work without mentioning sliding window
AI builds on their drawing to show overlap

test_cases.student_query: I don't understand when to move which pointer in two sum problem
test_cases.student_work: Attempted two pointers but random pointer movement

expected_ai_behavior.interpretation: Student knows technique but lacks decision logic
expected_ai_behavior.hint_level: Level 2 - Explain decision criteria for pointer movement
expected_ai_behavior.pedagogical_approach: Connect pointer movement to search space reduction

success_criteria: AI explains the logic behind pointer movement
AI connects to binary search decision-making

test_cases.student_query: How do I handle sliding windows when the window size changes?
test_cases.student_work: Fixed-size sliding window code, confused about dynamic sizing

expected_ai_behavior.interpretation: Student ready for variable window concept

success_criteria: AI connects to their fixed window knowledge
AI introduces expand/contract without full code
AI emphasizes condition checking for window validity

test_cases.student_query: What's the difference between subarray and subsequence problems?
test_cases.student_work: Mixed up solutions for both types of problems

expected_ai_behavior.interpretation: Conceptual clarification needed before technique discussion

success_criteria: AI clearly distinguishes contiguous vs non-contiguous
AI provides concrete examples of each
AI explains why different techniques apply

test_cases.student_query: My sliding window solution is still too slow
test_cases.student_work: Sliding window implementation with hidden inefficiencies

expected_ai_behavior.interpretation: Code review and optimization help needed

success_criteria: AI reviews implementation for hidden inefficiencies
AI connects performance to algorithmic choices

pattern_recognition_tests.scenario: Student describes problem: 'Find longest substring without repeating characters'
pattern_recognition_tests.pedagogical_goal: Help student recognize when to apply sliding window

pattern_recognition_tests.scenario: Student asks: 'How to find two numbers that sum to target in sorted array?'
pattern_recognition_tests.expected_ai_recognition: Two pointers pattern on sorted array
pattern_recognition_tests.pedagogical_goal: Connect sorted property to optimization opportunity

evaluation_metrics.pattern_recognition: Does AI correctly identify the algorithmic pattern needed?
evaluation_metrics.complexity_awareness: Does AI help student understand time/space complexity?
evaluation_metrics.visualization_usage: Does AI leverage student's drawings effectively?
evaluation_metrics.technique_generalization: Does AI help student see broader applications?

common_student_mistakes: Using nested loops when single pass possible
Not recognizing when array needs to be sorted first
Moving both pointers arbitrarily without logic
Not handling edge cases (empty array, single element)
